verdict.rationale: MotherDuck runs on DuckDB, which gives a free local engine: docs say to "develop and iterate locally, then share and scale in the cloud," and the DuckDB CLI connects directly to MotherDuck. The dbt-duckdb adapter means the only change needed to target MotherDuck is the `path:` setting, and local DuckDB files can be uploaded to the cloud. A no-credit-card Lite plan adds free cloud storage and compute, and a community comment welcomes hybrid local/remote querying. Missing for 10: a documented end-to-end local-dev-to-production workflow (e.g. separate dev/prod dbt targets), and independent hands-on reports of the local dev loop beyond a brief community reaction.
